checks.note: PHONE-CLOSE-CARDS: the SOL card's ONE [Details] button is found by its exact aria-label and is not a destructive control
the SOL card's ONE [Close] button resolves, and without a declared close intent it is refused (precision, not a click)
no card for a symbol that is not open: none, never another card
the same cards outside a region labelled Positions are not position cards
the app's first sheet target on the cards layout is the card's [Details] button (was no_grid: every tighten and close stopped at sheet_not_open)
and the element it will touch is that button, not the Close or TP/SL button beside it
every other target answers no_grid on the cards layout, which ends the app's target loop after ONE touch
an armed close with no sheet open clicks nothing (the card's own Close is not reached by the sheet path)
